decision: APPROVE bounded PRE-01 source correction and evidence integration; no new source blocker found
scope: Read-only exact-source review, portable tests and stubbed wrapper. No native Windows/PowerShell execution, no candidate runner evaluation, no provider/account/display/capture/policy activity, no external network and no repository writes by reviewer.
ordering: Initialization executes before the step loop; native snapshot is fresh and non-pixel, requires one primary physical rectangle [0,0,2560,1600] and system DPI192, and pins identity/work area.

Fresh native topology guard precedes Edge Start-Process. Start-App contains fresh owned-surface/native admission immediately before Electron Start-Process, after the existing 1500 ms launch-step delay.
captureStart resolves and caches the control websocket and encodes its expression before final surface admission; Invoke-Cdp uses that same socket immediately after admission.
Each rejection throws before its corresponding launch or capture action; runner abort handling and exact-identity outer cleanup are retained. Explicit redundant listDisplays was removed.

stub_wrapper_controls.limitations: Node VM evaluates exact JS wrapper. Child processes, writes and cleanup are stubs; PowerShell code is never evaluated.

limits: Admission is point in time. Renderer startup and capture click trigger asynchronous product thumbnail enumeration; a later OS hotplug/window change can occur before pixel acquisition. No atomic topology/window isolation is claimed.
Sixteen point ownership checks do not prove every pixel unobstructed; a documented exclusive controlled display allocation remains required.
Native C# compilation, Win32/DPI behavior and GUI/capture/input remain NOT_RUN. Delivered PowerShell parser evidence is retained, not independently rerun.
The driver is AI-disabled only. It does not make the four-action real-provider protocol executable or renew any resource allocation. Prior blocked evidence and real ledger 0/4 remain valid.

An initial reviewer-only VM assertion compared arrays across VM realms with deepStrictEqual and failed despite equal values; changed the scratch harness comparison to JSON equality. This was no candidate defect and preceded the successful 7-case run.

native_invocation_after_explicit_permiss.permission_owner: Lead obtains explicit approval before any renewed lease

permission_request.scope: One invocation of exact AI-disabled visible-drag diagnostic on owned generated surface, existing frozen1755153 package, exact scratch/userData/ports, synthetic CDP and guarded Win32 input, local capture and exact-process cleanup. Process-only RemoteSigned, inherited by that session children; no persistent policy/account/auth/provider/audio changes. Fresh exclusive display allocation required.
permission_request.followup_patch: Apply approved -ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned argument in wrapper rather than running runner directly; regenerate/check wrapper source digest in candidate manifest and affected evidence hashes. Keep runner/steps/surface bytes fixed unless separately reviewed.
permission_request.stop_if_denied: If script is marked/downloaded or Group Policy still refuses, stop. No Unblock-File, Bypass, persistent policy change, alternate execution engine or direct runner bypass.
